scenario: LDET.6.2.4 — denormal flush-to-zero is not permitted. Arithmetic on the smallest normal double (~2.225e-308) halved produces a denormal (~1.11e-308), which must remain strictly greater than zero. The rule fires only when (p.x * 0.5) > 0.0; if the runtime had FTZ enabled (via -ffast-math or SSE MXCSR.FZ), the multiplication would round the denormal to 0 and the rule would NOT fire. fact_count_after=2 (Probe + Sentinel) proves denormals are preserved.
rules_ds:
schema Probe scope logical:
    x: Float key

schema Sentinel scope logical:
    fired: Bool key

rule denormal_arith:
    Probe p where (p.x * 0.5) > 0.0
->
    emit Sentinel logical fired: true
